evidence.summary: 7.1 报告 All Ours-LSH/Quant 端到端达 10.7-10.8x 且保持 FA3 级质量，而 FlowCache+RadialAttn 仅 4.4x 并 'collapses in quality'；与表1一致。
evidence.short_quote: Combining cache compression with SA/CA sparsity yields the strongest overall gains: All Ours-LSH/Quant achieves up to 10.7– 10.8 end-to-end speedup while preserving FA3-level quality, while the best baseline combination (FlowCache+RadialAttn) reaches only 4.4 and collapses in quality.

notes: 方法性加速实证；论文未明列 limitation 段（author_status=not-found），故限制以 reader_inferred 记录。质量锚定 FA3 密集注意力与非任务级指标，不评测物理/因果一致性正确性，亦无分钟级世界模型能力验证（虽基线含 LongVie2）。
